invariants.rationale: The method iterates over 'orders'; a null value would cause a NullPointerException. Thus, 'orders' must not be null at exit.
The method throws if any element is null. Thus, all list elements must be non-null at exit.
The method throws if quantity is non-positive for any order. All orders must have positive quantity at exit.
The method throws if unit price is negative. All orders must have non-negative unit price at exit.
The size of a list cannot be negative; serves as a basic sanity check, though not particularly informative.
